Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses a combination of DDA for discovery interactomics (AP-MS) and PRM for targeted quantification of specific Polycomb subunits. While the study focuses heavily on H2AK119ub1 (ubiquitylation), the mass spectrometry analysis described for the interactome and global proteome used standard bottom-up DDA/PRM without specific diGly/ubiquitin-remnant enrichment (the H2AK119ub1 measurements were performed via immunoblotting and ChIP-Rx-seq, not MS-based ubiquitylome enrichment). Variable phosphorylation was set in MaxQuant.

scope: To gain insight into the USP7 network, we performed a series of affinity purifications followed by mass spectrometry (AP-MS).
We immunopurified Flag-tagged USP7 (Flag-USP7) from whole-cell extracts (WCEs) prepared from transfected human embryonic kidney (HEK) 293T cells.
The resulting immunopurified proteins on beads were directly processed for mass spectrometric analysis.
Immunopurified proteins were subjected to reduction with dithiothreitol and alkylation with iodoacetamide and digested on beads with trypsin

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study performed both AP-MS (interactomics) and global proteomics (WCE). Following the priority rules, the affinity-purified material used for the core interactome discovery is prioritized over the whole cell lysate used for global abundance checks.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a combination of CRISPR-mediated knockout and Dox-inducible rescue (overexpression) to analyze the USP7 regulatory network via global proteomics (WCE) and targeted proteomics (PRM).

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The study explicitly uses DDA (data-dependent acquisition) and MaxQuant with 'LFQ' and 'iBAQ' options for interactomics and global proteomics.

workflow: Spectra were acquired according to a data-dependent acquisition regime in continuum mode.
USP7 interactomics mass spectrometry data were analyzed using MaxQuant v1.6.0.16... with the additional options 'LFQ' and 'iBAQ' selected.
differential: t test–based statistics was applied on iBAQ data. First, iBAQ data were log2-transformed
Statistical outliers for the target protein IP data compared to controls were determined using a two-sample two-tailed t test.
search_parameters: cysteine carbamidomethylation was set as a fixed modification, while STY phosphorylation was set as a variable modification.
